text: Import the `sys` module. When you are in a virtual environment, `sys.prefix` points to the venv directory, while `sys.base_prefix` points to the global Python installation.
In a `requirements.txt` file, you specify exact versions with `==` and minimum versions with `>=`.
The built-in module for creating virtual environments is called `venv`. You run it as a module using `python -m venv <name>`.
To activate a venv on Linux/Mac, you use the `source` command on the `activate` script located inside the `bin` directory of the venv.
